summary.text: Zach Maier is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Angela Stiens (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an engineer and small business owner who founded two companies.

paragraphs.text: Maier graduated from Central Heights High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 2009, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as founder and CEO.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up on a Kansas farm, built parts of Google Maps, and has two daughters in the Shawnee Mission schools.
Maier won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat.

In the survey, Maier listed his priorities as increasing K-12 funding, fully funding special education, keeping public dollars in public schools, supporting startups and small business, keeping property tax control local, and legalizing and taxing recreational marijuana.
He also said he would pursue data protection laws and protect private medical decisions and LGBTQ+ freedoms.
